mapper.insert: insert into local_message (message_key, topic, event_type, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, payload_json, message_status, retry_count, next_retry_at, create_time, update_time) values (#{messageKey}, #{topic}, #{eventType}, #{aggregateType}, #{aggregateId}, #{payloadJson}, #{messageStatus}, #{retryCount}, #{nextRetryAt}, sysdate(), sysdate())
mapper.select: select * from local_message where message_status in ('PENDING','FAILED') and (next_retry_at is null or next_retry_at <= sysdate()) order by message_id limit 200
mapper.update: update local_message set message_status='SENT', sent_at=sysdate(), update_time=sysdate(), last_error=null where message_id=#{messageId}
